description: Run a prop bag through the real styling engine and get back the CSS each prop writes — or why it wrote none. This is the only way to be sure: an unknown prop and an unaccepted value both produce no rule and no class name, with no warning anywhere. Use it on any prop bag you were not certain about, especially numbers and colour tokens.

props.description: The props as JSON, exactly as written: {"p": 4, "bgColor": "blue-550", "hover": {"opacity": 1}}.

name: check_styles
title: Check props against the engine
